request.style: English, children's song, warm female lead vocal with kids choir, acoustic guitar, glockenspiel, xylophone, hand claps, gentle bouncy rhythm, counting sing-along, 108 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A shepherd had a hundred sheep
He counted them before his sleep
Ninety-seven, ninety-eight
Ninety-nine, but wait, wait, wait

[Chorus]
Ninety-nine and one, ninety-nine and one
He will not stop looking till the lost one comes
Up on his shoulders, home we go
Rejoice with me, for I have found my lost sheep

[Verse]
He left the ninety-nine to graze
And searched the hills and rocky ways
Behind a bush, beneath a tree
Baa, baa, here I am, it is me

[Chorus]
Ninety-nine and one, ninety-nine and one
He will not stop looking till the lost one comes
Up on his shoulders, home we go
Rejoice with me, for I have found my lost sheep

[Verse]
He did not scold, he did not frown
He laid it on his shoulders, homeward bound
He called his neighbors and his friends
Come and rejoice, the lost is found again

[Bridge]
There is joy in heaven, joy, joy, joy
When one who was lost comes home
It is not the will of your Father in heaven
That one of these little ones should be lost

[Chorus]
Ninety-nine and one, ninety-nine and one
He will not stop looking till the lost one comes
Up on his shoulders, home we go
Rejoice with me, for I have found my lost sheep

[Outro]
Ninety-nine and one
He found the one
